items.source: Pushes a zero onto the stack if the argument is a primitive class, or a null otherwise.
items.translation: 如果参数是基本类型类，则向栈中压入一个零；否则压入 null。

items.source: A time zone for which the cron expression will be resolved.
items.translation: 用于解析 cron 表达式的时间区域。

items.source: Editor for java.time.ZoneId, translating time zone Strings into ZoneId objects.
items.translation: java.time.ZoneId 编辑器，将时区字符串转换为 ZoneId 对象。

items.source: Sub-interface of ReactiveOutputMessage that has support for "zero-copy" file transfers.
items.translation: ReactiveOutputMessage 的子接口，支持“零拷贝”文件传输。
